pr_title: Fix lack of ProjectManager nullptr initializations
pr_body:
Initialize all pointers to nullptr, fixes a crash with asset_library caused by uninitialized memory.

Fixes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/59655

comments:
Happens here:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/482cdeaf718d77c24783a6b73281bfed886474ed/editor/project_manager.cpp#L1899-L1902
`asset_library` is not initialized to null, so it will randomly crash if not created.

The fix is simple, but we could use this opportunity to properly initialize everything in that file.
I went ahead and took care of it because it was a blocker.
